entries.exactAuthority:
KEEP Action,60feet,V/S/F and creating a magical forge that can craft items using Resonance Points. Preserve Core Instantaneous as the incomplete lifetime metadata. NEW create one fixed magical forge/anvil/work surface occupying a5-foot cube on a perceived stable unoccupied supporting surface in range/line of effect. It has actual300lb working mass, structural AC17/HP50, immunity to fire/poison/psychic damage and otherwise ordinary appropriate object defenses. It is a temporary conjured fixture, not detachable metal inventory or a creature. It lasts eight elapsed hours without concentration and provides controlled forging heat, ordinary anvil support and local ordinary working light within10feet, with no facility check bonus. It supplies neither the lead's actual Smith's tools/credential nor a complete secure workshop, Haven, storage, guards or another trade's station. Workpieces/material for the current order must fit its5foot work envelope and total at most500lb. It cannot be moved/recentered; actual loss of suitable support ends it.

NEW revision: eligible RP-funded production includes one otherwise legal, complete, reviewed Blacksmithing creation order, including its actual magical nonartifact recipe-imprint process. This is an explicit spell-specific acceleration of that entire recipe's active creation work; it is not restricted to mundane heating or metal-only ingredients. Use only a recipe with a complete operational output and a Forge-and-Anvil production interface whose real workpieces fit this fixture. All actual skill levels, tools, training, formula/discovery access, ingredients, ordered complete mundane base reservations, model/size/grade restrictions, work phases, output limits and required site category still apply. The forge supplies its compatible station and the stated work replacement; it supplies no base item, ingredient, formula or automatic success. An independently specified complete mundane metal-body recipe can also qualify if its source expressly permits this station for its entire active manufacture. Enchanting, Rune Carving and Tinkering are not admitted merely for containing metal: another trade needs its own complete reviewed compatibility rule. The forge cannot waive a required specialized facility or turn a field-prohibited recipe into field crafting. Living growth, incubation/calendar waits, attunement, recharge, servicing, repair, rework and formula research receive no manufacturing credit. Printing the recipe's actual magical imprint on its reserved body is now expressly permitted; inventing an artifact or an unreviewed output is not.

Preregister the one actual work order and source-authorized time modifiers first, rounding any legitimate modifier once under its own rule. Record the remaining adjusted active manufacturing minutes and original phases. One NEW forge cycle takes ten actual uninterrupted active minutes by the eligible lead and all claimed assistants and credits up to sixty of those remaining adjusted manufacturing minutes. This is an explicit replacement of work, not a demand to repeat the credited hour afterward. The final partial cycle still costs ten actual minutes and credits only its actual remaining work; unused credit is lost, never banked for another item/order. Choose ordinary work instead when that is preferable. No time feature further reduces this fixed ten-minute magical cycle or multiplies its sixty-minute credit unless a genuinely explicit later source says so. Other actual nonmanufacturing waits remain completely unchanged.

Before each cycle begins, one capable willing participant physically attending the forge for that cycle pays exactly5actualRP from one of their own legitimate RP pools. This may be the trained lead or a separate sponsor. These5RP are protected conversion principal: they cannot be discounted, waived, supplied by an unqualified imaginary pool or split into a nominal zero payment through Nexus/Influence. This operation is not another spell cast, does not use a second Counterspell window or Dissonance event, and cannot be financed by reusing the initial13RP casting payment. The sponsor's ten minutes are actual active participation and cannot also be rest, a different job or another forge cycle. Only a separately genuinely qualified full-time assistant within the recipe's cap supplies its actual+1; sponsorship itself grants no assistant bonus or trade XP.

Pay at the start and award work credit only after that entire legal cycle completes with the same real order, materials, tools, forge and participants. Interruption or loss of eligibility spends the paid RP and actual elapsed time but grants no partial cycle credit. Preserve earlier completed work according to the original work order's actual phase/stabilization procedure; the forge does not make an unfinished phase automatically secure or resurrect spoiled inputs. Suppression makes the fixture unavailable and interrupts an active cycle while the forge's eight-hour clock continues; unfinished real work/material remains where it physically was. Ending/destruction likewise drops only real stock and gives no RP refund, product or duplicate reservation. Rest cannot refill a paid cycle retroactively, and no source generates RP by dismantling the forge or its apparent fuel.

At actual completion of all remaining work, make exactly the ordinary one batch creation check and resolve its real six crafting outcome bands, natural1 Mishap, quality, source-qualified ancestry quality benefit, yield, catalyst retention and bounded failure recovery. RP does not guarantee success, grade, charges or a higher material tier. All actual ingredients/hosts and maximum-yield reserves are consumed/transformed/returned exactly once through their real recipe procedure. Finished output made from real reserved bodies and stock persists under its actual recipe-imprint procedure after this forge ends; the temporary fixture itself never becomes an ingredient, saleable item or permanent body reserve. NEW revision: retain the reviewed crafting learning procedure for the actual lead, including the actual recipe/trade identity, first-success history, triviality and ordinary success awards. The forge adds no XP multiplier, second work order, assistant award or reset of history. A failure-research award still requires its independently satisfied actual-input, actual-work and useful-finding predicates; credited recipe minutes are not falsely reported as elapsed personal work. The older proposal's blanket no-XP penalty is withdrawn in this unadopted revision because no governing source supplies it. Other pending spells, including Fabricate, are not changed by this proposal.

Only one order can use this fixture at a time, and one active Resonance Forge exists per caster. A successfully created replacement ends the old fixture without copying work/order/stock; failed formation leaves an old valid forge. The caster may dismiss it during their regular turn without an Action. ZeroHP, expiry, actual dispelling or loss of support ends it; temporary suppression alone can resume the same damaged fixture before its original deadline but never replays lost cycles. Workers count actual elapsed work minutes against EX58's daily work/rest limits, not the credited recipe minutes as a second Watch or free rest period. Real buyers, appraisal, price references and material provenance still govern any sale. The5RP/ten-minute/sixty-minute exchange and eight-hour station are consequential new balance choices awaiting joint review.

NEW explicit phase bridge: a completed ten-minute cycle grants its stated recipe-work credit within the current original phase. It does not automatically establish a new safe phase boundary. Reaching that source phase's full adjusted credit requirement stabilizes the incorporated inputs and progress under the source rule; elapsed perishability and personal work/rest clocks advance by actual time only. Forced interruption before a phase stabilizes loses that phase's unfinished credited progress, including credit from earlier completed cycles in that same phase, as the reviewed ordinary phase rule requires. Paid cycle RP is never returned. A voluntarily scheduled pause is safe only at an actual completed phase boundary or another source-permitted breakpoint. This bridge does not rewrite the recipe's material, failure or completion process.

exactAuthority.castingEligibility: KEEP Action,60feet,V/S/F,concentration up to60elapsed seconds and3d6 soldiers from an allied faction. Choose one actual canonical faction known to caster. At commitment and resolution require alliedStatus=true, institutional standing >0 on reviewed -3..+3 scale, actual permission to invoke faction magical aid, and no current aid ban. Membership alone is neither sufficient nor required unless institution says so. Hidden loss of eligibility gives paid failure without private-record disclosure.
exactAuthority.formation: Before commitment declare up to18 ordered perceived legal Medium whole-body spaces within60feet/LoE. After legal cast survives interruption and faction gate remains valid, roll3d6 once. Form up to rolled count using first still-valid declared spaces in order; if too few remain, form fewer with no new after-roll placement/refund/delayed soldier. Bodies are temporary magical faction representations, not transport/copies/conscription of named personnel and grant no secret memories, legal rank, signatures or real-faction inventory.
exactAuthority.authoritativeProfile: Each formed body uses AC6-FACTION-SOLDIER-PROFILE-01 exactly: Medium 5x5, mass160lb, AC14, HP20, walk30, STR12 DEX12 CON12 INT8 WIS10 CHA8; saves use original source-owner current PB total; other checks use listed ability modifier absent exact proficiency. Martial Strike is one melee spell attack reach5 using original source-owner current spell attack, 1d8 slashing no ability modifier. Apparent arms/armor are intrinsic and non-detachable.
exactAuthority.commandAndBodies: All soldiers are separate bodies/HP/positions but share owner's existing one Bonus Action command and one offensive companion Action per numbered round with every other asset. One valid command selects one soldier and one legal movement budget plus profiled/basic Action in attached phase. Other capable soldiers may move defensively/Dodge under existing companion rule. No army-wide volley, independent turns, extra offense, unprinted Reaction/ranged attack/spellcasting/profession or roster office.
exactAuthority.cargoAndHealing: Each soldier has two hands/feet, up to100lb AND6Load genuine carried capacity subject to actual hand/equipment/body rules. Intrinsic attack needs one usable hand but supplies no detachable weapon. AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02 applies separately while body exists for otherwise legal HP healing; healing above0 clears only that body's NullDisabled state. Intrinsic equipment never becomes inventory; real supplied objects keep identity/custody.
exactAuthority.lifecycleAndSuppression: One active cohort per caster. A genuinely formed nonempty new cohort replaces old cohort; concentration transition may end old earlier. Ordinary non-Null0 ends that individual body; qualifying Null damage can leave same NullDisabled0 body while parent exists. Use AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01 exclusively: full parent suppression pauses all existing soldier bodies; local suppression pauses only intersecting bodies. No early-destruction suppression rule is current. Later faction standing/permission changes affect future casts/social consequences but do not retroactively end an admitted cohort absent an actual source-ending rule. Expiry/concentration ending/eligible parent removal ends all remaining bodies; intrinsic equipment vanishes and real cargo drops once.
exactAuthority.damageRoot: Each commanded soldier attack has dealer/root owner = that soldier body, not owner/controller.

entries.name: Alignment Nexus
entries.scope: Only the AC6 source relationships expressly covered by exactAuthority; no automatic extension to unrelated spells, profiles, global rules or cosmology.

exactAuthority.access: KEEP one source identity with two fully distinct printed operations. Current actual class rows grant Divination6/base13/range60 to Cleric11, Wizard11, Mirrorsage16 and Shaman16; they grant Conjuration8/base21/range120 to Druid15 and Mage15. No other mode is granted by a global minimum-rank/header, another school's progression or this proposal. Both retain Action and V/S/F. All original placements, including conflicting global metadata and Core Instantaneous, remain intact as evidence. NEW each mode receives its own explicit finite concentration duration below.
exactAuthority.alignmentAndBonus: At successful resolution snapshot the caster's actually defined effective complete alignment pair after accepted underlying history/overlays. If either axis is genuinely undefined, the paid cast establishes no Nexus and supplies no alignment diagnosis. This pair never changes for that application. A creature benefits only when its actual current complete effective pair matches at the creation of an eligible roll. NEW the Nexus insight benefit is +2 to that creature's actual attack-roll, saving-throw and ability-task modifier, before rolling. It changes no AC, damage, DC, HP, RP, rank, critical range, proficiency, automatic result or fixed opposed total. The source's actual normal resolution and information rules still apply. A reroll/replacement of that same original event retains its original modifier set under its own source, rather than resnapshotting alignment to ratchet a bonus.
exactAuthority.overlapAndIdentity: Both modes share one explicitly NEW family, alignment-nexus.insight. A creature receives at most one+2 from that family at an event, regardless of casts, modes, plane effects or casters; choose the earliest eligible active source for equal applicable benefits. This does not reclassify any unrelated class/item bonus into a new universal stacking family. One active Alignment Nexus per caster across both modes. Beginning either new concentration ends the caster's old concentration under ordinary rules even if the new cast later fails. Other casters retain independent records and clocks.
exactAuthority.readout: Eligibility supplies no public roster, alignment identification, oath permission, compelled choice, belief change or origin inference. Hostile matching creatures can benefit just as allies can. Neither mode rewrites alignment to make a creature qualify. Its own bonus is a local magical expression at the beneficiary; actual local suppression can suspend that expression without changing the underlying alignment record.

currentIntegration.modeAccess: Use only the actual class row: Cleric11/Wizard11 Divination6 13RP 60ft; Mirrorsage16/Shaman16 Divination6 13RP 60ft; Druid15/Mage15 Conjuration8 21RP 120ft. No global header creates a portal placement.
currentIntegration.transportClassification: AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01: Conjuration8 crossings are planar transitions and teleportation for this spell only. This intentionally differs from accepted AC5 Alignment Portal.
currentIntegration.portalBodies: Each live mouth is a fixed physical 10-foot-wide by 15-foot-high aperture with exact pose. Whole-body entry and exit footprints must fit. The portal itself does not create difficult terrain. Actual terrain rate is 1/2/3 movement per foot, then crawling adds +1 per foot and squeezing +1 per foot. Thus 5ft difficult+squeeze costs15ft; difficult+crawl+squeeze costs20ft.
currentIntegration.planeBenefit: AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01 preserves the temporary destination-plane +2 aligned-recipient benefit while parent is live; this is spell metadata, not intrinsic plane alignment/cosmology.
currentIntegration.blockers: Actual accepted Dimensional Anchor tests the traveler transition endpoints, not portal formation. Other exact voluntary/teleport predicates use their own text. Closing the portal grants no free return; travelers remain where they actually are.
currentIntegration.durations: Divination6: concentration up to60 elapsed seconds. Conjuration8: concentration up to600 elapsed seconds. Each has its own absolute deadline from successful establishment; no shared 60-second portal deadline.

Divination6.formation: NEW fixed30foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within60feet and caster line of effect; concentration up to60elapsed seconds. The chosen center must be on the caster's actual current plane. Its insight benefit reaches eligible creatures with a body portion in the sphere and center-to-body line of effect, including the caster if eligible. It is a nonphysical magical zone, not illumination, cover, a wall or a new perception sense. It does not move with the caster.
Divination6.events: Check actual current plane, geometry, line of effect and effective alignment when each attack/save/task roll event is created. Entering/leaving, changing alignment or losing local eligibility changes future roll eligibility without a free new roll, spell cast or Action. No entry pulse, charge reserve, duration gift or lasting buff is acquired. Extra turns can contain genuine eligible rolls but create no special bonus budget. Partial local suppression removes only the affected current benefit; its clock and parent concentration continue.
Divination6.ending: Ordinary expiry, concentration ending, replacement or an actual eligible whole-source removal ends the zone. It has one rank6 parent record, not a list of separately cast spells. A fixed zone with no independent creature-target branch is ineligible for Xi's creature-branch ending. It gives no distant roll readout or retroactive revision of a completed roll.

Conjuration8.destinationAndSourceChoice: NEW full portal operation, not an insight zone substituted for travel. Choose an actually different plane and a specific destination place whose real physical layout the caster has personally perceived, either by visiting or through a source-authorized ordinary visual view such as Planar Window. A mere map name, secondhand direction, imagined ideal, omen or invented cosmology is insufficient to locate an endpoint. The Director records genuine stable origin/destination plane identities privately; distinct labels alone cannot pass the different-plane condition. Choose exact two opening faces and arrival spaces before commitment. Unknown or changed real destination conditions are resolved after paid commitment with no diagnostic report or substitute plane.
Conjuration8.newEmpowermentInterpretation: NEW consequential interpretation for joint review: the spell temporarily makes the selected destination plane empower creatures matching the cast's snapshotted pair, rather than requiring or asserting that the plane is eternally aligned. While this Nexus operates, its +2 insight benefit applies to every actually eligible creature physically on that destination plane, including preexisting inhabitants and enemies, whenever a qualifying roll occurs. This is deliberately plane-wide to retain the full destination-empowerment promise; it is not reduced to a receiving-pad buff. Evaluate it on actual roll events, without scanning or revealing a population. This temporary magical effect establishes no permanent planar affinity, creation history, soul jurisdiction, objective Wheel mapping, rest rule or moral allegiance. The scope and interpretation are NEW and unadopted, requiring explicit GPT review and later balance assessment.
Conjuration8.openings: NEW concentration up to600elapsed seconds. Form two fixed, visible vertical rectangular openings, each10feet wide and15feet high, linked face-to-face with a recorded neutral orientation. The whole origin opening and its five-foot-deep receiving clearance must be within120feet and caster line of effect. The remote opening/receiving clearance use the exact known destination layout rather than imaginary cross-plane line of effect. Both openings initially need actual unoccupied clear physical aperture volume and a front-side receiving region at least10feet wide,15feet high and5feet deep. A larger traveler needs additional actual receiving clearance at transit. An unsupported but otherwise empty fitting destination is permitted; the spell creates no floor, flight, breathing protection or environmental immunity. A traveler arriving without real support immediately follows its actual Falling/other movement rules. A hidden failure prevents the complete portal pair and empowerment after costs are committed. The spell creates no body in the gap and no third intermediate transit plane.
Conjuration8.transit: While both mouths are operative, a whole actual body may cross by spending five feet of available real movement from an adjacent reachable side; the body and its carried noncreature gear must fit the opening and legal receiving space. Ordinary physically permitted squeezing can apply if it truly allows that whole body through, without automatic resizing. Actual independent forced movement can carry a body through if that movement reaches/crosses the opening and all its own permissions remain legal; the Nexus itself compels nothing and grants no free movement. Separate riders/passengers/carried creatures remain separate bodies. A genuinely inseparable group declared by its actual transport situation is one atomic transaction and every body must fit and satisfy its own blockers. Otherwise bodies cross in a fixed actual event order and occupancy can stop later travelers. Real independent objects/projectiles can cross if they fit and possess actual movement/force. No remote stock is duplicated or pulled through merely by opening the gate. NEW receiving placement: before a particular transit commits, declare the receiving whole-body footprint/pose on the exit's front side, with the nearest edge of that footprint no more than5feet from the exit plane and every body point on the receiving side. It must be a real perceived or personally known location through the actual opening view, fit the current whole body/group and obey the declared exit orientation; it is not a remote retarget beyond the receiving space. Hidden/intervening occupancy is checked after a valid commitment and can defeat that paid movement without a substitute. All bodies retain their actual anatomy, dimensions, load and gear; no slot is reserved against other travelers. The five-foot minimum setup clearance alone does not prove that a Large or larger body fits.
Conjuration8.rangeSightAndAttacks: The open gateway transmits ordinary light and sound along the real unobstructed route through its two apertures. This is a view of the actual destination, not a remote caster body or origin substitution. NEW a genuinely physical nonspell projectile or thrust may pass through the opening with its own legal attack, visibility and remaining range: measure the actual route to the entrance plus from the exit, with zero additional path length for the paired mouth transition. The real attack retains its dealer/root, defenses and event identity. This includes a physical weapon with separately legal magical enhancement; it does not turn its attack into a second cast. A spell or other effect with an actual same-plane targeting/origin restriction keeps it; the gateway does not waive components, concentration, source-origin, target-type or planar limits or authorize casting from the remote mouth. An effect needs its own genuine authority for any nonphysical cross-plane delivery.
Conjuration8.preventionAndFailure: Test each actual transported body's origin and destination against applicable teleport/planar-transition prevention, including Dimensional Anchor, and the actual distinction between voluntary and involuntary travel in the preventing source. This operation is a planar transition and teleportation for these NEW Nexus transit rules; no imaginary intervening-world path is tested. A known invalid transit is not begun. If an obstacle/blocker becomes effective after a valid movement commitment, that transaction stays wholly at its actual origin with already-spent movement/resources retained; no nearest-safe relocation, new destination, partial body or retry occurs. Obstruction of a mouth can block a current transit without ending the entire spell. The gateway grants no universal ward bypass; ordinary Banishment's special terminal closure is unrelated to voluntary Nexus transit.
Conjuration8.suppressionAndClosure: Local suppression intersecting an opening makes that mouth unavailable for transit while the original clock continues. Local suppression at a beneficiary suspends only that creature's current insight expression. Suppression of the caster alone does not automatically end an already established concentration unless its actual source says so. An effect expressly suppressing the entire Nexus suspends both mouths and empowerment within its actual scope. Nothing queues missed moves or bonuses. On expiry, concentration ending, replacement or eligible parent removal, both mouths and all Nexus insight benefits end. Every completed traveler/object remains at its actual current location; there is no automatic return journey, refund or rescue. A transit resolves atomically before or after a closing event under actual event order, never half inside a severed body. If an endpoint's actual containing place ceases to exist, this Nexus ends rather than inventing a location to hold it. Existing source-specific mandatory body settlement remains that other source's responsibility.
Conjuration8.removalAndCustody: Both mouths are addressable manifestations of the same rank8 parent for an actually eligible dispel; ending the parent at either operative mouth ends both and the empowerment. It does not end an independent other Nexus. Plane-wide empowerment is one continuous zone-like effect with no independent creature-target branch, so Xi cannot end the whole plane effect by targeting an arbitrary beneficiary. Ordinary actually applicable narrow suppression/removal sources retain their own scope. All real cargo, bodies, personal custody, permits and institutional consequences remain real on the side where they are. Neither an unseen native population nor private plane facts are reported by the benefit.

entries.exactAuthority: NEW scoped DE4-GUARD-01 amendment: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from any of these three spells, across all casters, coins, marks, Fate Reversal permissions and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these three spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use stable actor IDs then stable source/application IDs fixed before the original event, with the same stable tie-break for initiative ties. When the actual lifecycle supplies no qualifying phase at the recorded boundary, perform an expiry-only bookkeeping check at that original marker and remove the instruction. This check grants no movement, Action, Reaction, recharge, control START, command or owner resource expenditure. An owner-attached target with no original schedule therefore expires at application+6 if no independently supplied lawful phase occurs first. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. entries.name: DE4-RNG-05
entries.scope: Only source relationships expressly covered by this exact DE4 authority; no global extension, automatic acquisition or cosmological settlement.
entries.exactAuthority:
NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

SOURCE POLICY BINDING: DE4-PRESENTATION-06 in this same pending revision supplies only its five explicitly proposed entries. Unlisted events remain denied. Both documents require exact joint acceptance before live application.

entries.name: DE4-PRESENTATION-06
entries.scope: Only source relationships expressly covered by this exact DE4 authority; no global extension, automatic acquisition or cosmological settlement.
entries.exactAuthority:
NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

entries.name: Fate Reversal
entries.scope: Only source relationships expressly covered by this exact DE4 authority; no global extension, automatic acquisition or cosmological settlement.
entries.exactAuthority:
Action; V/S/F. NEW: establish one personal pending permission for one minute without concentration; a successful recast replaces your prior unused permission. Core’s 60-foot range applies to the later roll’s actual generating creature/object or local event, which you must perceive with line of effect. The battlefield phrase grants no unlimited reach. After the complete initial attack, save or check d20 result is available under ordinary information rules, but before its consequences, spend your Reaction and this permission to replace the entire d20 procedure using its original modifiers and advantage/disadvantage state. A two-d20 procedure receives two new dice and normal higher/lower selection; a single-d20 procedure receives one. Use the new result even if worse. Process natural results only from the final roll under its actual attack/task/save rules. No damage, healing or resource die is covered. NEW: this joins Mark Omen and Fate Coin’s shared one-reroll guard for one original roll event and its entire replacement lineage, across all casters and recasts. Reserve that guard at legal commitment; competing declarations use initiative order or the preexisting stable actor/source order under DE4-RNG-05. An already barred declaration spends neither permission nor Reaction. Exact class rerolls retain their own timing but never reset this three-spell guard. Suppression blocks use while the original timer continues. Replaced dice generate no duplicate cast, payment, hit hook or completed consequence; interruption after commitment refunds nothing. No secret roll is revealed and no finished consequence is reversed.

CURRENT SHARED-RULE AMENDMENT: This procedure is conditional on explicit joint approval of DE4-GUARD-01 and the complete nine-file amendment draft. The previously accepted two-spell guard is not silently changed by this local proposal. Use the complete original attack/save/check d20 procedure; an automatic success/failure without an actual roll supplies no d20 event to replace. Fate Reversal is not limited to one engine RNG die component like Fate Coin, and adds no information about hidden rolls. No source permits choosing a favorable subset of advantage/disadvantage dice. If the personal permission is actually suppressed, no use is legal; if an operative use commits but a protected event blocks its Divination alteration under DE4-SEAL-LOCI-02, record its real spent permission/Reaction/guard and retain the original result.

DIGITAL CONFERENCE: Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full. The physical coin item and the engine RNG component are distinct. All nine current guard representations have exact unadopted transformations in amendment04. No source-specific visibility grant is created by this replacement permission.

entries.scope: Only source relationships expressly covered by this exact DE4 authority; no global extension, automatic acquisition or cosmological settlement.
entries.exactAuthority:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: choose one willing perceived creature with line of effect, including yourself, OR a fixed 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point with line of effect. Concentration up to one minute. The creature mode follows its actual body without a continuing range tether. In area mode, protection applies to creatures and effects while their relevant footprint is inside with line of effect to the center. Block effects of actual Divination-school spells on those protected subjects, using the generating cast’s real school placement. This deliberately includes noninformational Divination buffs, marks and reroll permissions, unlike Protection from Scrying’s information-only scope. Suppress an existing affected component without deleting it; prevent a new component from establishing. Leaving or suppression removes this ward’s protection while surviving old components retain their original deadlines. A Divination observation point inside supplies no feed while protected; an outside point cannot obtain protected information about subjects inside but can still read independent permitted surroundings. Queries about a protected creature return the querying spell’s neutral unavailable result, without a reason or roster. A Divination reroll cannot alter a protected roll-generator’s event. Ordinary senses, independent records, remembered facts and non-Divination powers remain governed by their actual rules. NEW self-consistency exception: Seal Vision’s own protective records are exempt from suppression by any Seal Vision, so overlapping seals do not disable each other. Other seals add no magnitude and each retains its source and clock. No blindness, physical concealment, spellcasting ban or general antimagic follows.

NEW LOCUS COMPLETION: Apply DE4-SEAL-LOCI-02 in full. This distinguishes protecting the operator's pending Divination permission, the actual affected target component, and the original event that a still-operative reroll attempts to change. Do not selectively change a shared roll for only unprotected recipients or turn its unchanged non-Divination damage into a blocked Divination attack. The existing same-family Seal exemption prevents mutual shutdown; independent areas keep their own original clocks. The proposed area/body-intersection and retained Fate Coin physical-body handling are explicit new choices, not historical source facts. AC6 Current06 is accepted. Apply its exact Globe origin/recipient/rank predicate and source-local Nexus insight expression. Seal Vision remains a proposed actual-Divination-school ward with no rank ceiling: an operative Seal can suppress the local Divination6 Nexus benefit, while Conjuration8 Nexus is outside its school predicate. Globe does not block a rank6 Nexus or suppress established creature-attached effects. A new rank4 Seal from outside an operative Globe is blocked for its protected recipient under the Globe source. An inside-origin Seal remains legal. No Nexus dispel, cross-plane protection or general antimagic is inferred.

entries.exactAuthority:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; one minute without concentration. NEW: one willing perceived creature with line of effect, including yourself, gains advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves, plus +2 to each of its INT and WIS ability scores. This is a score increase, not +2 to every derived modifier. Each score increase is capped at 20; a preexisting score above 20 is not reduced and gets no increase from this spell. Apply the strongest competing flat bonus to the same score, not additive duplicate casts. Recompute actual ability modifiers and only statistics that genuinely depend on their current values: checks, saves, spell attacks/DCs, applicable limits and explicitly dynamic class resource maxima. Existing fixed or snapshotted values keep their source timing. Temporary increases do not grant class levels, repertoire, prepared spells, trained skills, permanent prerequisites or fresh uses. Ordinary concentration remains CON-based unless an actual source says otherwise. The mental-save advantage does not create extra saves or modify unmodified death saves. Ending, suppression or replacement recomputes the same effective values without resetting any pool, preparation, acquisition or clock.

CURRENT SOURCE TIMING: Apply the plus2 INT/WIS score and mental-save advantage only while this application is operative. An applying condition/spell DC already recorded by its source remains that recorded DC; a genuinely new cast computes its actual current ability modifier. Each printed class resource is read by its own acquisition/recovery timing. For example Druid Buffer Reserve is recorded after a beneficial Long Rest as2L+M; this temporary spell alone neither repeats that rest nor changes a previously recorded reserve. Class limits explicitly using a current modifier can change only within their actual wording. Do not convert every appearance of M into a new dynamic maximum, prepared slot or learning entitlement. Rising maxima give no refill; a real falling dynamic maximum uses only the accepted cap rule without damage/resource-gain triggers. Duplicate advantage remains one advantage, and any actual disadvantage cancels it under Core regardless of source count.

Choose one known exact canonical faction and one concrete institutional subject, such as an operational plan, a resource or a policy. entries.scope: Only this exact source-qualified spell procedure with its accepted full shared context and class/school access.

exactAuthority.completeText:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous 8d6 fire and blinding all enemies in the area. NEW center a 60-foot-radius sphere on the caster; this operationalizes the source range as its radial reach, with no remote center. Include every other creature in the sphere that the caster actually perceives and currently regards as an enemy, with caster-origin line of effect. The caster cannot selectively omit a perceived enemy after seeing saves. This is the caster's contemporaneous hostile selection, not a detector of secret allegiance, morality or hidden bodies. Allies, objects, buildings and worn/carried gear are not damage targets of this hostile-creature-only profile.

Each recipient makes one CON save. Roll 8d6 fire once. NEW success takes half, rounded down, and no blindness. Failure takes full damage and, after that packet, attempts Blinded on the same still-eligible creature if it could actually visually perceive this flash at the original snapshot. Sightless anatomy, an already fully opaque eye covering or an actual optical barrier prevents that visual rider, not fire damage. A real defense against Blinded prevents only that condition. Fire immunity can reduce damage to zero without preventing visually delivered blindness. Seeing the flash through ordinary glass does not defeat a glass barrier that independently blocks the spell's line of effect; both predicates must hold. A creature cannot claim a retroactive eye closure after learning its save; any genuine previously established closed-eye state carries its ordinary sight restrictions.

NEW this source-owned Blinded record lasts until the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding a turn already underway when applied; outside initiative it lasts six elapsed seconds. It is nonconcentration and can end through actual condition cure, eligible removal/dispelling, death or its deadline. Suppression suspends the rider without resetting its clock. Multiple sources retain their actual deadlines while the same condition has no multiplied penalty. A later real cast may create its own finite blindness record but cannot replay the earlier damage. Ordinary Blinded consequences apply; unaffected nonvisual senses keep their actual scope. No whole-Action denial allowance is spent solely by Blinded. The flash grants no continuing light source, sunlight trait, Deafened, Stunned, Prone, ignition, blast movement or environmental fire. Subsequent entrants receive nothing.

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.scope: Only this exact source-qualified spell procedure with its accepted full shared context and class/school access.

exactAuthority.completeText:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous 10d8 lightning to one primary and arcs to three secondary targets. NEW choose one primary perceived creature or independently legal exposed object within 60 feet and caster line of effect, then up to three distinct secondary eligible creatures/objects that the caster actually perceives. Each secondary must satisfy the explicit same-point-pair primary-volume30-foot range and line-of-effect test below at the original pre-damage snapshot. A secondary need not be within 60 feet of the caster, but perception must be genuine at its actual distance. No one identity can occupy two selections, including a large body's overlapping spaces; the primary cannot receive a returning arc. Exclude hostile worn/carried gear unless an actual separate source permits targeting it. Independently targetable objects need real durability/material defenses; the spell does not invent a vulnerable HP track for a wall of force, artifact or undefined world feature.

For a direct cast declare all selected identities before commitment. For a legally readied casting, select and recheck those identities at release under the accepted Ready rule; spell/mode and all preparation costs were already committed. After the interrupt window, recheck the primary and all selected secondary predicates using the then-current positions and fix that one pre-damage snapshot. If the primary has become illegal, the spell has no anchor and gives no damage or arcs; costs remain spent. An unavailable secondary is simply omitted, with no replacement after outcomes. NEW every included creature makes an independent DEX save for full 10d8 on failure or half on success. The missing secondary quantity is expressly completed as the same full 10d8 lightning as the primary, not assumed from an external ruleset. Roll the raw 10d8 once for the whole cast; ordinary target defenses and separate recipient packets apply. Legal objects take that amount without a creature save unless their actual object profile supplies one.

The arcs are established from the legal primary whose actual primary application is permitted at the snapshot, not purchased by damaging it. A successful primary save, lightning immunity, full prevention of HP damage or death from its own packet does not cancel already established arcs. There is no attack roll or miss result in this save-based proposal. Each secondary's save, immunity or death likewise has no effect on another. Total effect-blocking cover on one arc removes only that arc at the snapshot; destroying that cover later in the event cannot restore or add it. All four identities share the one cast and raw-roll identity but keep separate damage roots and actual source-trigger scope. No recursive secondary arcs, rebound hits, new targets in conductive water, blindness, stun, ignition or ongoing electrical field are added. Up to three means a legal cast can have zero, one, two or three available secondaries without manufacturing targets or forcing harm to an unchosen ally.

NEW AC6 CURRENT INTERFACE COMPLETION FOR CONFERENCE: At the successful post-interrupt snapshot the primary must be a legal target and an operative primary application must be permitted, before it can supply this spell's secondary emissions. An actual field preventing that primary application prevents the dependent arcs; mere damage immunity/defense/prevention, save outcome or subsequent primary death does not. The real primary body at the pre-damage snapshot is the expressly authorized origin for each secondary arc for geometric/Globe predicates. This changes no dealer: the original caster remains each recipient root's dealer under Null. Recheck each secondary's actual payload defenses independently without retargeting, recursive arcs or a second target scan. This local origin/primary-application distinction is NEW and requires review against the accepted ward interfaces; it is not already granted by random Chain Arc.

NEW DC25-CHAIN-LOCUS-01, CHAIN LIGHTNING ONLY. Use the primary's exact actual occupied body or eligible object's collision volume snapshotted after real cast interruptions. A secondary qualifies only if there exists one same pair of actual primary/secondary points joined by an unobstructed segment of at most30 Euclidean feet. The distance witness cannot come from a blocked near face while line of effect comes from a different out-of-range far face. The caster must still actually perceive every selected secondary; this test grants no remote perception from the primary. This is an explicit new extension for this spell, not inheritance of random Chain Arc's target selection, range metric, public dice, owner or recursion. The original primary volume is the authorized physical arc-source locus; it never becomes a new caster/dealer. Snapshot it before damage. Primary immunity, prevention of HP loss, or its later damage-caused death is not absence of the original operative application and does not move this locus. Conversely, if that primary application is itself prevented at the established permission checkpoint, there are no dependent arcs. Determine each secondary's own actual prevention/cover at its original selected endpoint; a shared RNG value gives neither a shared recipient root nor a new application through a blocker.

Origin-sensitive accepted fields use that expressly authorized real primary arc locus for dependent arcs and the actual generating rank of this spell. Ordinary rank6 Chain Lightning is ABOVE the accepted Globe0–5 ceiling; do not claim that its normal arc is blocked by Globe, or reduce its rank merely because an RP discount/waiver applied. No origin is invented at a desired secondary point, through a wall, or at the caster's display cursor. The chosen selected identities and snapshot are not rescanned after damage.

NEW the source-owned blindness lasts until the target's next future original regular-turn END, excluding a turn already underway when applied; outside initiative six elapsed seconds. entries.name: Freezing Sphere
entries.scope: Only this exact source-qualified spell procedure with its accepted full shared context and class/school access.

exactAuthority.completeText:
Action; point range 60 feet; V/S/F; instantaneous. KEEP 10d6 cold in a 60-foot radius and actual water freezing. NEW choose a perceived point within range with caster line of effect. Snapshot all creatures whose actual bodies intersect the true radius-60 sphere with center line of effect, including allies and the caster when qualified. Each makes CON against the actual casting-class spell DC: full shared 10d6 on failure, floor-half on success, then actual defenses. This is one instantaneous damage pulse, not recurring damage, a stored orb, Frozen, Paralysis or automatic equipment damage. Roll/dealer/Null/recipient lifecycle follow the shared current rules. Cold immunity of a body does not itself protect separate water.

WATER SNAPSHOT. The environmental operation takes only the finite original ordinary exposed liquid-water volume within that same actual sphere, no deeper than one vertical foot below its preexisting exposed surface, with both a real unobstructed exposure path to that surface and the environmental operation's actual line of effect. Local prevention of that environmental manifestation excludes its affected part before a phase change; a later dispel cannot undo an already completed real phase change. Sealed roofs, ice caps, beds and solids are not scanned through. No later flow is added. Exclude living tissue/bodily fluids, water incorporated in food or another mixture, sealed vessels, and hostile worn/carried containers. A genuine caster-held or voluntarily offered open vessel can contribute only its actual water. Preserve salt, contaminants, custody, original water-source lifetime, no-sale restrictions and spent hydration history. No standard density, purity, extra Supply or new ingredient is inferred.

CLEARANCE — NEW DC25-ICE-GEOMETRY-01, FREEZING SPHERE ONLY. Resolve the instantaneous creature damage and its mandatory life/body/cargo consequences before the environmental change, without rescanning for new recipients or adding new water. Subtract every then-extant body and independent object volume from the original candidate water. For each such body/object intersecting the selected surface layer, also subtract its vertical expressed horizontal collision silhouette through that selected layer up to the preexisting exposed surface. This creates only an UNFROZEN WATER COLUMN, not air, an exit, movement, breathing, a new squeeze, or a tunnel. Do not shrink the silhouette to trap a larger expressed body. Where an actual obstruction prevents that straight vertical clearance, conservatively leave unfrozen the whole original selected-water connected component touching that body/object; other disconnected candidate components may freeze. Connectivity is through original selected water, never through a wall or a closed vessel. This deliberately replaces the prior undefined 'shortest route' with a bounded conservative exclusion. It does not repair an already trapped/drowning state or prevent later ordinary cold damage, source expiry, death or anatomy changes. No external event is cancelled to maintain clearance.

MATERIAL GEOMETRY. Phase change preserves the remaining water's exact occupied volume and actual recorded mass, with no pressure-expansion attack. Record one root material lot and its exact frozen solid geometry. World +z is up. Give it an immutable section grid: 5-by-5-foot x/y squares on world coordinates that are integer multiples of five feet; separate vertically disconnected slabs in a square are separate components. Clip each component to the actual sphere, surface-depth band, exclusions and original water boundaries. The section grid is accounting only, not permission to replace a curved intersection with a rectangle. Shared faces have zero volume and belong to only one accounting component by fixed x/y/z order. A smaller open pool contributes its actual clipped shape. No new ice fills an excluded column or connects two separated solids. Floating/ground support needs actual supporting water/ground; no unsupported bridge or levitation is created.

BOUNDED DEFAULT PROFILE. An independently established applicable ice/material profile wins. Otherwise each original full 25-square-foot component at least six inches thick has AC12, 20 maximum/current structural HP when first formed, ordinary weapon susceptibility, poison/psychic immunity, fire vulnerability, and at most 500 lb of load while truly supported. For every smaller or thinner original component, let f_HP=min(1, actual horizontal plan area/25 square feet, actual solid volume/12.5 cubic feet); initial maximum/current HP is floor(20*f_HP). This explicitly includes shallow puddle ice thinner than six inches rather than leaving its durability undefined. Its support budget is 500 times the actual >=6-inch supported horizontal area/25 square feet, capped at500lb; thin areas contribute zero support. A positive-mass component rounding to zero HP is fragile/broken material, not absent material, and supplies no creature support. Thin portions below six inches supply no default creature-support permission. Neither cutting nor relabeling a component grants a new full 20 HP/500 lb allocation.

SUPPORT AND BREAKAGE. The default supports a body's load only when its actual support contacts, or its full expressed ground footprint where no more specific contact profile exists, are continuously backed by qualifying >=6-inch supported intact ice. Distribute the actual load among overlapped original sections in proportion to that support-contact area; include carried weight and simultaneous existing loads. A section's current support budget never exceeds 500 times its currently qualifying horizontal area/25. Child pieces share that area budget, not independent 500 lb maxima. Fire thinning, cuts, holes, source removal and broken connectivity require an immediate support check. An overloaded component loses its intact support and becomes the same finite broken material; do not create crushing or an extra spell packet. Use actual Falling/swimming/body rules for an unsupported creature. The rule grants no automatic ground or water-breathing destination.

SPLITS AND HP. A physical cut must come from an actually legal source/tool operation with a declared real cutting surface; Freezing Sphere grants neither that operation nor free fabrication. If that operation genuinely partitions a component, child geometry is exactly the disjoint partition and their exact mass fractions equal volume fractions under this explicit spell-lot model. Allocate the parent's remaining maximum integer HP proportionally by exact rational child-volume shares, floors then largest remainders; ties use ascending child (min x,min y,min z,stable fragment ID). Allocate its remaining current HP proportionally to those assigned child maximum-HP capacities by the same rule, so no child exceeds maximum and both totals are conserved. Zero-max-HP positive-mass fragments stay real broken/fragile material. All children retain lot identity, contamination/custody restrictions and elapsed thermal exposure. Current HP is never reset by splitting. Voluntary recombination grants no restored HP, new section budget or unseen recipe.

FIRE AND PARTIAL MELT. Only an actual authorized fire/heat interaction with the material applies this profile; a creature-only fire spell does not acquire object targeting. For a positive-current-HP addressed component, resolve its actual defenses, including fire vulnerability, then let L be structural HP actually lost (capped at HP immediately before that fire). Melt fraction L/HP_before of its current intact volume AND mass into the same water. Fire overkill creates no extra water. NEW deterministic erosion: remove the topmost portion of that component by world-z horizontal clipping until precisely that volume has melted. Choose the highest cut level achieving the required volume when an empty-height interval gives ties. Keep the surviving solid at its original coordinates; record meltwater in the vacated geometry before ordinary environmental flow. This is spell-lot erosion bookkeeping, not global heat physics. Remaining current HP is HP_before-L; remaining maximum HP is max(remaining current HP,ceil(old maximum HP * retained-volume fraction)), never above the old maximum. Partition any disconnected survivors with the split allocation above. Re-evaluate support using actual remaining thickness/shape. At L=HP_before all addressed intact ice melts; no fragment of that same melted volume remains.

NONFIRE ZERO AND ALREADY-BROKEN PIECES. A nonfire structural loss to zero does not erase or melt mass: record a finite loose-fragment aggregate in the same original geometric envelope with structural HP0 and no intact wall/platform/support permission. It may be carried or separately partitioned only through actual item/carrying/tool rules. It receives no regenerated structural HP. NEW bounded heat completion: an independently legal positive fire-damage application to a specified already-broken zero-HP aggregate melts that addressed aggregate completely; not every other fragment in the lot. Ambient heat instead follows the remaining thermal clock. This supplies a defined finite result without an invented fresh smaller-piece HP profile. No loot, XP, source-cost refund or living damage-root trigger comes from relabeling broken material.

SLIP. Supported ice is difficult terrain. Make at most one DEX slip save against the original spell DC for this source lot in a creature's original regular-turn cycle, at the first voluntary entry or its regular START on the lot, never both. Failure makes it Prone under the actual condition; success grants no unrelated immunity. All child sections share that one spent-slip record. Extra turns, mode changes, leaving/reentering and splitting the lot do not reset it. At a published attached companion phase use that actual original phase/cycle; no new independent creature turn is granted. Without an original schedule, use fixed six-elapsed-second passive hazard intervals anchored to the first exposure, with no Action/Reaction/recharge refresh. Forced entry is not an immediate slip roll but a still-present body can face the next scheduled hazard check. If several independent such ice lots require the same first surface check, use the highest applicable source DC then earliest stable application-ID for one check, marking those simultaneous checks spent; this tie completion is Freezing-Sphere ice only. Existing Prone or actual Prone immunity does not cause extra fishing for rolls or a new disclosure permission.

THERMAL CLOCK AND CUSTODY. Absent a real applicable heat profile, each current material component fully melts after 3600 cumulative elapsed seconds in above-freezing conditions. Freezing conditions pause, not reset, that exposure. Splits inherit the parent's elapsed exposure exactly; subsequent distinct exposures can diverge per real fragment. Fire-melted water and remaining ice are disjoint portions of the same material ledger. Full thaw, earlier real source expiry or actual material removal ends only the material that source governs. An item name such as 'insulated' grants no new thermal rule. Real environmental heat may thaw earlier under its established profile. After the instantaneous phase change, suppression/dispel does not reverse physical ice, breakage or consumed water. Preserve actual contaminants, custody, capacity, use/sale restrictions and original source expiration throughout. No stored projectile, pure-water yield, rare stock or general refrigeration entitlement is created.

exactAuthority.completeText:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous explosion for 6d6 necrotic and blindness against Undead. NEW choose one perceived point within range/line of effect, and snapshot every creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere with center line of effect, including caster and allies. No separate perception of an indiscriminate recipient is required. Roll 6d6 necrotic once for the event; each creature makes CON. Failure takes full, success half rounded down, then its actual defenses and damage pipeline. Objects and corpses are not creature recipients and receive no packet from this proposal.

Independently, a creature actually classified Undead at resolution that failed that same CON save attempts a Blinded application. Other creature types receive only their appropriate damage. The same save is used for damage and the rider, but damage magnitude is not the blindness trigger: actual necrotic resistance, immunity, temporary HP or an HP floor does not cancel an otherwise admitted failed-save blindness. Blinded immunity or an actual broader defense can prevent that condition without altering the separate necrotic packet. Appearance and the word Undead in a name do not supply classification. The cast provides no private classification report, although ordinary visible consequences can be observed.

NEW blindness lasts until the target's next future regular END, excluding the END of a turn already underway when it applied. Outside initiative its maximum is six elapsed seconds, preserving the original endpoint through initiative changes. A companion-only recipient uses the next future actual original-owner regular attached phase END, excluding a phase underway, or the original six-second spell-only endpoint if no phase exists; this supplies no additional phase or action. No concentration, repeat save, special rousing, continuing range tether or fear component is added. Apply actual Blinded consequences and existing nonvisual-sense exceptions. After the spell's separate fire/bludgeoning save rounding, select applicable defenses under their actual sources. NEW Meteor-only equal-amount tie completion: when no more specific source chooses between equal competing flat reductions, choose the lexically first stable source-mechanical-ID and then application-ID, fixed before any resistance/immune outcome; this is not a player optimization or a global stacking rule. Use exact rational arithmetic for this comparison. Zero-valued or ineligible components receive no share. No component becomes negative. Do not use a later resistance/immunity result to change the allocation.

Ordinary selected class flat reduction occurs before typed resistance/immunity. A selected Spinal Plating reduction occurs after typed resistance. entries.name: Inferno Wave
entries.scope: Only this exact spell procedure, its actual access and complete source-specific root mapping. No new permission from pending counterparts.
entries.exactAuthority: Action; V/S/F; instantaneous wave, no concentration. KEEP 60-foot line and 6d6 fire. NEW: a straight line from the caster, five feet wide and five feet high, in a declared direction; being its origin alone does not include the caster. Stop at a total solid obstruction. Snapshot all eligible creatures, each making DEX for full 6d6 fire on failure or half on success, with one shared raw roll. The wave itself has no general object-damage packet. KEEP its distinct ground-ignition clause: after the snapshot, ignite genuinely exposed combustible ground/floor material intersecting this footprint, including dry surface vegetation or an actually burnable wooden surface. Bare stone, water, saturated ground and unsupported air supply no fuel. NEW finite small-fire completion: divide actual ignited footprint into at most twelve five-foot patches, each clipped to the line and its available fuel. Before applying a patch, record the real combustible substrate, the finite amount that actually ignites, its physical burn endpoint no later than sixty seconds after ignition, and actual extinguishing method. If available fuel burns out sooner, use that earlier endpoint; no invented fuel mass, structural HP loss or total floor collapse follows from the spell. Each patch is an ordinary physical flame, not a continuing spell or Core Burning applied to a creature. It remains until fuel/endpoint or real extinguishing, independently of caster concentration, dispel or suppression of other magic. NEW hazard: a creature in contact with its burning surface takes 1d6 fire without a save on first actual entry or its regular START there, at most once per Inferno-ground-fire family/target/round across all patches and owners. A creature eligible for the initial wave counts as exposed to this family for that same round even if its save/defenses prevent damage; it takes no second immediate ground packet. No creation pulse, airborne heat damage or extra-turn START is added. A wholly suppressed original cast creates neither wave nor ignition; suppression after actual ignition cannot unburn material. Real dousing or complete smothering can end a contacted patch; one adjacent creature may spend an Action using actual sufficient water, sand or a usable nonburning cover to extinguish one patch, with no roll and no fabricated equipment. A source effect such as Tidal Wave can extinguish the ordinary flames it genuinely contacts. NEW conservative fire boundary: these patches do not automatically spread or persist past their recorded endpoint. Continued/spreading environmental fire requires a separately established ordinary hazard and remaining real fuel, never a fresh spell packet or free manufactured stock. Reignition is possible only for actual remaining unburned material and never resets a current round exposure.

entries.name: Freezing Rain
entries.scope: Only this exact spell procedure, its actual access and complete source-specific root mapping. No new permission from pending counterparts.
entries.exactAuthority:
Action; V/S/F. KEEP the casting-point range of 30 feet separately from the 30-foot radius and the 4d6 cold per round. NEW replace the contradictory Instantaneous duration with concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds. Choose a perceived point within range with line of effect; create a fixed vertical cylinder thirty feet in radius and twenty feet high, centered vertically on that point. Its volume and affected surfaces are clipped by actual solid cover from the center; rain does not cross a roof or sealed floor by name alone. All legal creatures in that volume make CON at creation, then at each source six-second pulse before expiry. Roll shared 4d6 cold for each pulse: full on failure, half on success. NEW family cap: initial and periodic cold together affect a target at most once per Freezing Rain identity per round across owners/casts. Each pulse takes a fresh geometry/cover snapshot. Entry, forced movement, reentry, extra turns or suppression ending adds no cold tick; entering can expose a creature at the next genuine pulse. Damage is independent of the slippery ground. NEW slippery surface: actual exposed walkable surfaces inside the active cylinder cost double ground movement, using ordinary difficult-terrain arbitration without multiplying an existing double cost. At the first voluntary ground-movement expenditure on a covered surface in a round, after the first up-to-five-feet segment, make DEX against the first encountered active rain’s recorded DC; failure applies Prone if the creature can receive it. This slip check is family once/target/round, shared across casts, walking and attempts to stand then move. Already Prone creatures spend the same opportunity but receive no additional condition; ordinary crawling and standing costs remain. Standing alone does not trigger it, and forced movement, falling, flight and teleportation do not themselves spend ground Speed or force a slip save. A failed creature still chooses how to use remaining legal movement/actions. The rain supplies no Frozen, restrained body, attack penalty or magical Speed reduction; terrain therefore is not a Balanced Elements slow. Suppression removes only that source’s active cold/terrain effects while original clocks and spent history continue. At ending, all its magical rain and slipperiness vanish, with no residual ice, drinking water, repair material or harvestable stock. Existing mundane weather and unrelated terrain remain.

CURRENT MOVEMENT PRECISION — NEW P20-RAIN-CONTACT-07, Freezing Rain only: For the first continuous voluntary ground trajectory contacting an operative covered surface in a numbered round, accumulate actual contacted distance, not nominal Speed expenditure. Resolve the one DEX slip check at the earliest of (a) five actual contacted feet, (b) a genuine earlier voluntary stop, or (c) the boundary at which that continuous contacted portion ends because the continuing voluntary trajectory leaves all operative Freezing Rain-covered surface. Under (c), resolve the check after paying the contacted distance and before spending movement on the outside continuation. A zero-duration frame/input split is not a stop or a coverage exit; touching or crossing internal patch/owner boundaries without leaving the union of operative covered surface does not reset the accumulator. At a geometric contact-loss boundary use the completed contacted path length up to that boundary; no epsilon distance grants a second check or free travel. A one-foot real move followed by a stop checks after that foot. A short exit without stopping likewise checks before outside continuation; it cannot evade the check solely by leaving before five feet. If movement remains wholly within covered surface and has not stopped, retain the accumulated length across frame and command subdivisions until one of the stated checkpoints occurs. Standing alone, teleportation, airborne motion, Falling and forced movement still do not themselves generate this voluntary ground-slip check. A failed check applies actual Prone without refund; continuation requires the creature's then-legal crawling, standing and movement budgets. The family once-per-target/per-round opportunity is shared across owners and remains spent even when Prone immunity prevents the consequence. This is not a global slip rule or a Crystalline Growth timing change.
